An individual wouldn’t want to take a loss

2026 so far:

- Alcaraz completes the career Grand Slam (youngest ever) and then gets injured and does play the next two Majors. 

- Sinner rolls through the clay season and loses second round at RG and then rolls to his second Wimbledon title. 

- Zverev finally grabs a Major after losing 3 finals in the absence of Sinner and Alcaraz along the way. 

- US Open: Alcaraz returns from a long injury layoff and Sinner is out with a knee injury. 

Crazy to say the least.
